status: Discussion draft — proposed assignments, not catalog changes

group_notes.Falmer: Proposed Beastfolk gameplay convention; preserve Falmer ancestry in descriptive tags.
group_notes.Giant: Propose ordinary giants alongside Frost Giants in Beastfolk; retain the specific kind as a tag.
group_notes.Chimer: Proposed explicit historical exception: the Dark Elf collection includes Nerevar and Veloth, still tagged Chimer.
group_notes.Nede: Proposed explicit cultural exception: Alessia belongs to the Imperial collection, still tagged Nede.
group_notes.Hero: Proposed explicit cultural exception: Pelinal belongs to the Imperial collection; Hero is descriptive, not a group.
group_notes.Reachman: Review the five Reachfolk subjects individually. Do not automatically relabel a distinct people Breton or Beastfolk.
group_notes.Ash Creature: Review the depicted subject: ash-spawn, corprus and Sixth House servants cannot all inherit one replacement group.
group_notes.Imp: Confirm the intended creature and its source before choosing Spirit or Daedra.
group_notes.Gargoyle: Confirm the depicted gargoyle's nature before choosing Construct or another group.
group_notes.Ayleid: Decide whether Umaril has a defensible place in this taxonomy or should be replaced; no automatic High Elf assignment.

legends-253948.note: Yagrum Bagarn: proposed retirement with Dwemer people; he is not a Construct.

tessera-dumac-dwarfking.note: Dumac: proposed retirement with Dwemer people; he is not a Construct.

tessera-kagrenac.note: Kagrenac: the same proposed retirement as Yagrum and Dumac. Preserve the machine subjects.

legends-246681.note: Skeevaton: mechanical form takes precedence over the animal it resembles.

legends-245823.note: Clockwork Dragon: proposed Construct; confirm the subject and art before removing Dragon.

legends-304376.note: Ayleid Guardian: proposed Construct; inspect the animated guardian depicted. Defense is a source-game role.

legends-283869.note: Lyris Titanborn: propose Nord as her sole gameplay group; retain Giant ancestry as a descriptive tag.

legends-298299.note: Mankar Camoran: the current High Elf / Wood Elf split needs a deliberate depiction and identity decision.

legends-298871.note: The Gray Fox: decide whether the card depicts a particular bearer or the anonymous legend before assigning a race.

legends-276326.note: Tiny Dragon: replace or redesign for a verified Dragonling / folkloric subject; do not raise its stats to tier VI just to satisfy the Dragon range.

legends-276314.note: Baliwog: check the source relationship to Grummites before inheriting Beastfolk from the old group.

legends-276445.note: Baliwog Tidecrawlers: check the source relationship to Grummites before inheriting Beastfolk from the old group.

legends-276320.note: Hulking Scalon: review independently; the old Grummite label does not establish its proposed group.

legends-209049.note: Senche-Tiger: proposed Khajiit only if the intended subject is the furstock. Verify the art and naming rather than treating every tiger as Khajiit.

legends-209228.note: Ice Wraith: proposed Spirit; confirm the creature's nature rather than inferring undeath from the name.

wispmother.note: Wispmother: review Spirit versus Undead without presenting an uncertain origin as settled lore.

legends-289870.note: Dro-m'Athra Reaper: proposed Daedra; resolve the cosmological case explicitly rather than inheriting Khajiit / Undead.

legends-291138.note: Vastarie: review the lich depiction for Undead; High Elf remains descriptive ancestry.

legends-283628.note: Mannimarco: establish whether this is a mortal, lich or deified depiction before choosing High Elf, Undead or God.

legends-291229.note: Cadwell: resolve the Soul Shriven depiction rather than treating the existing Imperial tag as a complete classification.

legends-276699.note: Haskill: resolve the intended depiction and nature before confirming Breton or another group.

legends-223563.note: Flesh Atronach: check the specific source's animating nature; Atronach in Legends does not settle Daedra, Construct or Undead.

legends-277257.note: Seething Flesh Golem: check the depicted creature's creation and animating nature before assigning a group.

legends-253826.note: Fetcherfly Golem: review source and art; do not map every golem to Construct or inherit Daedra blindly.

legends-276308.note: The Gatekeeper: confirm the treatment of this specific created being before choosing Daedra or Construct.
